description: Read one saved listing draft in full: the four fields it was scored on, the context it assumed, the score it reached, and the findings behind it. This is what list_metadata_simulations cannot carry, and it is what makes a past run worth picking up: the text is here. Pass the "id" of a row from list_metadata_simulations, or the "saved.id" a simulate_metadata call returned. Read-only and instant.

id.description: The saved run id (numeric), from list_metadata_simulations or from simulate_metadata's saved.id

name: get_metadata_simulation
